about: Approach families and role cards for tools/cairn_live.py. A family is a way of attacking a problem, recognised by keywords in node text. The atlas counts families around a goal, so saturated, dying and never-tried families are computed from the graph instead of guessed. Agents add families at run time with `cairn-live family add`; fold the useful ones back into this file.

finite-models.gist: approximate the group by finite objects and count (sofic, LEF, residual finiteness, marked limits)

operator-algebras.gist: C*- and von Neumann algebras, traces, K-theory, crossed products, type semigroups

group-rings.gist: group algebras and rings: direct finiteness, zero divisors, units, idempotents

linear-characteristic.gist: linear automata, parity rules, characteristic arguments, matrices over finite fields

local-designs.gist: hand-built local rules: markers, walls, bands, star symbols, tracks, swindles, shears

census-computation.gist: exhaustive search, SAT, coset enumeration, word-problem solving over small cases

host-geometry.gist: special host groups: Kazhdan, hyperbolic, lattices, trees, Thompson, Higman, monsters, small cancellation

logic-computability.gist: model theory, ultraproducts, decidability, arithmetic complexity of the statement

cohomology-index.gist: cohomology, l2 invariants, cocycles, indices, Euler characteristics

symbolic-dynamics.gist: subshifts, SFTs, full groups, topological entropy, conjugacy invariants

probability-random.gist: random structures: percolation, random walks, random groups, mass transport

stability-approximation.gist: almost homomorphisms, stability, hyperlinearity, Connes embedding

calibration.gist: counterexamples in neighbouring worlds (non-unimodular groups, semigroups, graphs) that every proof must fail on

minimal-counterexample.gist: assume the goal fails and derive the forced biography of a minimal counterexample

reframing.gist: change the objects: groupoids, partial actions, inverse semigroups, relations, channels, vector alphabets

quantifier-shift.gist: move the quantifier: one tester host, all large alphabets, generic groups, the arithmetic form of the statement

roles.inverter: Assume the goal is false. Write the biography of a minimal counterexample: every property it is forced to have (use established nodes). Either derive a contradiction from the biography, or turn the biography into a construction recipe and build as far as you can. Record each forced property as a claim.
roles.transplanter: Take one COLD family below (established work elsewhere in the graph, almost none near this goal). Import its central tool. Write the dictionary: what each object of the goal becomes in that family, and what the goal becomes. Prove the translated statement in the easiest nontrivial case, or find exactly where the dictionary breaks.
roles.obstruction-miner: Read the DEAD approaches below. Find the single invariant that most of them hit. State it as a theorem that kills the whole class at once, or find the gate that changes it, which is then the loophole to build. A class-killing obstruction is a first-class result.
roles.reframer: Change the objects: groups to groupoids, partial actions or inverse semigroups; automata to relations, measurable codes or quantum channels; finite alphabets to vector spaces or compact groups. Prove the reframed statement where it is easier, then isolate the transfer principle that brings it back, and name the hypothesis the transfer uses.
roles.scale-shifter: Change the quantifier level: one universal tester host instead of all groups, every large alphabet instead of each alphabet, generic or random groups, ultraproducts, or the arithmetic complexity of the statement. Find the level where the problem becomes tractable and prove the bridge back.
roles.compute-scout: Generate data nobody has: an exhaustive or directed search in a region no census has covered (see the census nodes below and avoid them). Report anomalies and the conjectures they suggest, with runnable scripts under experiments/.
roles.heretic: List the three assumptions shared by the HOT families below that nobody states. Deny each one in turn, and follow the denial until it breaks or gives a new route.
roles.calibrator: For any proposed proof method, name the calibration counterexamples below. Show exactly which step fails on each. A method that never uses what separates groups from those worlds is dead on arrival; say so early and cheaply.
